165:t_1:92.en:
$$バナージ$$
($$マリーダ$$... Why did this happen to you...?)

165:t_1:94.en:
$$シャア$$
「May I? I'll intrude for a moment.」

165:t_1:96.en:
$$シャア$$
「Please don't be so tense. We fought together, however briefly.」

165:t_1:97.en:
$$シャア$$
「Or do you have no intention of talking to a former enemy?」

165:t_1:98.en:
$$バナージ$$
「No... I believe I understand that you had your reasons.」

165:t_1:99.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But that doesn't mean I intend to approve of your starting a war.」

165:t_1:100.en:
$$シャア$$
「That's fine. Please cherish that sensibility.」

165:t_1:101.en:
$$バナージ$$
(It's strange... This is similar to my exchange with $$フル・フロンタル$$ in $$パラオ$$, but the impression is completely different...)

165:t_1:102.en:
$$バナージ$$
(Is this... the true $$赤い彗星$$...?)

165:t_1:103.en:
$$シャア$$
「Are you comparing me with $$フル・フロンタル$$?」

165:t_1:105.en:
$$シャア$$
「You needn't hide it. You're one of the few people in $c who has met him in person.」

165:t_1:106.en:
$$シャア$$
「But now... there's no meaning in discussing who is real and who is an imitation.」

165:t_1:107.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Is that because he... has become $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s leader?」

165:t_1:108.en:
$$シャア$$
「Exactly. If he becomes, as he says, a vessel for the $$スペースノイド$$s' feelings, then the name $$赤い彗星$$ would suit him too.」

165:t_1:109.en:
$$シャア$$
「Still, I doubt I'll ever come to like him.」

165:t_1:110.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...Why did you come to see me...?」

165:t_1:111.en:
$$シャア$$
「I wanted to speak to you about $$マリーダ・クルス$$.」

165:t_1:113.en:
$$シャア$$
「...The idea of $$強化人間$$s and the history of cloning technology go back even further than the 《$$一年戦争$$》...」

165:t_1:114.en:
$$シャア$$
「Back then, the $$ジオン公国$$... no, Republic of $$ジオン$$ sought to fix its troop shortage and train elite soldiers for the coming war with the $$地球連邦$$.」

165:t_1:115.en:
$$シャア$$
「That was the first $$強化人間$$ project in history. The clones created from superior genes as its base subjects were called the Proto-$$プル$$ Series.」

165:t_1:116.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$プル$$... It can't be...」

165:t_1:117.en:
$$シャア$$
「Their number 12... $$プロト・プルトゥエルブ$$ is $$マリーダ・クルス$$.」

165:t_1:119.en:
$$シャア$$
「They grew well and were expected to become excellent $$ジオン$$ soldiers in a few years...」

165:t_1:120.en:
$$シャア$$
「But history advanced faster than imagined. The $$一年戦争$$ began far sooner than expected... They were still too young for the battlefield.」

165:t_1:121.en:
$$シャア$$
「Instead, they were given powers beyond mere physical enhancement...」

165:t_1:122.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You mean $$ニュータイプ$$ abilities...」

165:t_1:123.en:
$$シャア$$
「Yes. And amid the flames of $$ア・バオア・クー$$, they saw the $$白い悪魔$$ destroy their allies' machines one after another.」

165:t_1:124.en:
$$シャア$$
「It must have been etched in their memories as a hated enemy that forced them down a cruel path of destiny.」

165:t_1:126.en:
$$シャア$$
「Even my subordinate, a foremost expert on $$ニュータイプ$$ research, couldn't trace where each of them went afterward.」

165:t_1:127.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But...! But $$マリーダ$$ is still caught in battle... and against her wishes!」

165:t_1:129.en:
$$シャア$$
「And you're piloting that $$ガンダム$$.」

165:t_1:131.en:
$$シャア$$
「...$$ミネバ$$ told me how you came to pilot the $$ユニコーン$$. And in the $$時獄戦役$$, I saw what kind of person you are for myself.」

165:t_1:132.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What are you trying to say?」

165:t_1:133.en:
$$シャア$$
「I thought you had resolve, but it appears I overestimated you.」

165:t_1:134.en:
$$シャア$$
「In your present state, I doubt I can even ask you for the next coordinates for the Box.」

165:t_1:135.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Are you seeking the Box too?」

165:t_1:136.en:
$$シャア$$
「If it causes pointless fighting, I've considered burying it forever...」

165:t_1:137.en:
$$シャア$$
「But I hear $$リディ・マーセナス$$ called it a prayer that turns into a curse.」

165:t_1:139.en:
$$シャア$$
「It's a wish for the future raised at the birth of the $$宇宙世紀$$... Don't you want to know it?」

165:t_1:141.en:
$$シャア$$
「I suppose you're not ready now...」

165:t_1:142.en:
$$シャア$$
「But I want you to think once more about being with the key to the Box... with humanity's potential...」

165:t_1:143.en:
$$シャア$$
「And about what it means for that to be a '$$ガンダム$$'.」

165:t_1:146.en:
$$シャア$$
「It's you, $$ブライト$$. The captain has come in person.」

165:t_1:148.en:
$$シャア$$
「Don't ask why. Still, I imagine my reason is the same as yours.」

165:t_1:149.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I suppose we've both grown old.」

165:t_1:150.en:
$$シャア$$
「Unlike you, who's properly fulfilling your role as a parent, I've taken nothing but detours.」

165:t_1:151.en:
$$シャア$$
「I've finished what I came for. I'll leave the rest to you.」

165:t_1:155.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Following up after the $$赤い彗星$$ makes me a little nervous.」

165:t_1:156.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...I'd like to talk with you. May I, $$バナージ$$?」

165:t_1:157.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Is it about the Box's coordinates...?」

165:t_1:159.en:
$$バナージ$$
「There's... no point expecting anything of me... I'm... already...」

165:t_1:160.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Someone like me... piloting a $$ガンダム$$ and tormenting $$マリーダ$$...」

165:t_1:161.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I only got into the $$ユニコーン$$ by something like chance in the first place... Yet I...」

165:t_1:164.en:
$$ブライト$$
「It may have been chance that a $$ガンダム$$ was in front of you then.」

165:t_1:165.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The others who piloted $$ガンダム$$s before you... $$アムロ$$, $$カミーユ$$... it was the same for all of them.」

165:t_1:166.en:
$$ブライト$$
「But... whether to pilot a $$ガンダム$$ was your own decision. It couldn't have been chance. ...Am I wrong?」

165:t_1:168.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Try to remember what made you decide to pilot the $$ガンダム$$ then.」

165:t_1:170.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Have you calmed down a little?」

165:t_1:171.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Thank you, Captain $$ブライト$$. I...」
